empty_program: Empty! New idea: 'while not at goal' keeps going until you arrive, so you don't have to count the squares at all.
unbalanced_block: Every 'while not at goal' needs an 'end while' below it, wrapping the steps you want to keep doing. Check yours has one.
infinite_loop: Your program went round and round and never stopped. A 'while not at goal' only ends when you actually reach the goal -- check yours can get there.
hardcoded_no_loop: That works, but you had to count every square. 'While not at goal' keeps stepping until you get there -- no counting.
